# Moby-Dick playback description fixture

Host playback description and timeline results for `../moby-dick-mo.epub`
(SHA-256 `749a9de094c26bc79351722a2bf320845dc5f6af2d5bf41a96d720d723b29a4c`), used by
`tests/browser/synthetic/media-overlays.spec.ts`.

Generated by the Elephant Ladder native host from the byte-identical
`elephant-ladder/tests/fixtures/media-overlays/moby-dick-mo.epub`:

```sh
cargo test -p elephant-ladder-native-host export_moby_dick_navigator_fixture -- --ignored
```

Run it from `elephant-ladder/src-tauri/crates/native-host` with this repository checked out
beside it. Regenerate whenever the host playback description contract changes.

`../moby-dick-excerpt.ogg` is the host's desktop narration transcode of the first 40 seconds
of the chapter audio, generated the same way:

```sh
cargo test -p elephant-ladder-native-host export_moby_dick_opus_excerpt_navigator_fixture -- --ignored
```
